title: Neil Armstrong discusses a UFO research group with Hynek

tellings.quote: It was Neil Armstrong who asked to sit with my father and family. And turns out that he did talk with my father and they talked seriously about creating a new UFO research group.

plain: The son of J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer known for studying UFOs, says that in the early 1970s Neil Armstrong, the first man to walk on the Moon, asked to sit with his father and the family. According to the son, the two men talked seriously about starting a new group to research UFOs. If true, it would mean one of the most famous astronauts took the subject to heart.
